name: Default
shortDescription: Browser-driven AI coding agent with a password-protected Web UI and persistent sessions, settings and workspace.

alerts.message: Sign in as user dsh with DSH_PASSWORD from the template environment, then add a DeepSeek or other model API key under Settings - Models before starting a session.

DeepSeek Harness is a developer preview with compatibility-breaking changes between releases. The agent can run commands and modify files in the workspace volume; share this instance only with trusted users.
